clauses.heading: INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT
clauses.text:
INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 14 March 2025 between Zephyr Media Private Limited,
Mumbai (hereinafter "the Client"), and Ms. A. Bose, a freelance designer
residing at Salt Lake, Kolkata (hereinafter "the Contractor").
clauses.plain_english: Identifies who the parties to this contract are.

clauses.heading: SERVICES
clauses.text:
1. SERVICES
The Contractor shall provide graphic design services as described in each
statement of work agreed between the parties from time to time.
clauses.plain_english: A general provision of this contract.

clauses.heading: FEES
clauses.text:
2. FEES
The Client shall pay the Contractor Rs. 80,000 per month within forty five days
of receipt of a valid invoice for the preceding month.

clauses.heading: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
clauses.text:
3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
The Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all intellectual property, designs,
artwork and materials created by the Contractor during the term of this
Agreement, whether or not created for the Client and whether or not created
using the resources of the Client.

findings.title: Assignment of IP beyond the work itself
findings.matched_quote: assigns to the Client all intellectual property, designs, artwork and materials created by the Contractor during the term of this Agreement, whether or not
findings.plain_summary: This may take ownership of work you did on your own time.
findings.why_it_matters: Narrow it to work actually made for this engagement, and attach a schedule listing anything you built beforehand that you want to keep.

clauses.heading: TERMINATION
clauses.text:
4. TERMINATION
The Client may terminate this Agreement at any time without assigning any
reason by written notice with immediate effect. The Contractor may terminate
only by giving ninety days written notice.

findings.title: Only one side can terminate at will
findings.matched_quote: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time without assigning any reason
findings.plain_summary: The other side can end this at any time, without a reason.
findings.why_it_matters: Check whether you have the same right on the same notice. An asymmetric termination right is the single most common one-sided term, and the easiest to get made mutual.

clauses.heading: DELAY
clauses.text:
5. DELAY
In the event of delay in delivery of any deliverable, the Contractor shall pay
a penalty of Rs. 2,000 per day of delay until the deliverable is accepted.

findings.title: Penalty stated as a fixed sum

citations.note: Where a sum is named as payable on breach, only reasonable compensation up to that sum is recoverable -- and actual loss must still be shown.

findings.plain_summary: A fixed sum is payable if this is breached.
findings.why_it_matters: The named figure is a ceiling, not an entitlement. Whoever claims it must still show real loss, so an alarming number is often worth far less than it appears.

citations.note: Where a sum is named as payable on breach, only reasonable compensation up to that sum is recoverable -- and actual loss must still be shown.

clauses.heading: INDEMNITY
clauses.text:
6. INDEMNITY
The Contractor shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Client against any
and all claims, losses, damages and expenses of whatever nature arising out of
or in connection with the deliverables or this Agreement.

findings.title: Indemnity with no financial ceiling
findings.matched_quote: indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Client against any and all claim
findings.plain_summary: You cover the other side's losses without any upper limit.
findings.why_it_matters: An uncapped indemnity can exceed everything the contract is worth to you. Ask for a cap tied to the fees paid, and for it to exclude indirect losses.

clauses.heading: NON-COMPETITION
clauses.text:
7. NON-COMPETITION
The Contractor shall not, for a period of twelve months after the termination
of this Agreement, provide design services to any competing business of the
Client.

findings.title: Post-employment non-compete
findings.matched_quote: shall not, for a period of twelve months after the termination of this Agreement, provide design services to any competing

citations.note: Every agreement restraining anyone from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business is void to that extent. Indian law has no 'reasonableness' exception for restraints operating after the contract ends.

findings.plain_summary: This stops you working for a competitor after you leave.
findings.why_it_matters: Under Indian law a restraint that bites after the contract ends is void, not merely hard to enforce. It can still be used to threaten you, and to withhold a relieving letter, so it is worth negotiating out even though a court is unlikely to uphold it.

clauses.heading: GOVERNING LAW
clauses.text:
8. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at Mumbai
shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

missing_clauses.title: No limitation of liability
missing_clauses.why_it_matters: Your exposure is unbounded. A cap tied to the fees paid is standard and is usually accepted if asked for before signing.

missing_clauses.title: No confidentiality clause
missing_clauses.why_it_matters: Nothing restricts what the other side may repeat about your business.

redlines.title: Assignment of IP beyond the work itself
redlines.ask: Ask for the assignment to be narrowed to work actually made for this engagement, and attach a schedule of what you already own.
redlines.suggested_wording: The Employee assigns to the Company intellectual property created in the course of the Employee's duties and using Company resources. Material listed in Schedule [X], and anything created outside working hours without Company resources and unrelated to the Company's business, remains the property of the Employee.
redlines.fallback: At minimum ask to exclude work unrelated to the employer's business and created on your own time and equipment.

redlines.title: Post-employment non-compete
redlines.ask: Ask for this clause to be deleted, or cut back so that it only applies while you are still employed.
redlines.suggested_wording: The Employee shall not engage in any competing business during the subsistence of this Agreement. No restriction shall apply after the termination of employment.
redlines.fallback: If it will not be removed, ask for the period to be cut to six months, the geography limited to the specific city, and the restriction to name particular named competitors rather than any competing business.

redlines.title: Indemnity with no financial ceiling
redlines.ask: Ask for a financial cap on the indemnity and for indirect losses to be carved out.
redlines.suggested_wording: The indemnifying party's aggregate liability under this indemnity shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement in the twelve months preceding the claim, and shall exclude indirect, incidental and consequential loss and loss of profit.
redlines.fallback: If no cap is accepted, ask at least for it to be mutual and limited to third-party claims caused by your own proven breach.

redlines.title: Only one side can terminate at will
redlines.ask: Ask for the termination right to be mutual, on the same notice.
redlines.suggested_wording: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving the other not less than sixty days prior written notice.
redlines.fallback: If they keep a shorter notice period, ask for a payment in lieu covering the difference.

redlines.title: Penalty stated as a fixed sum
redlines.ask: Ask for the fixed sum to be replaced with actual proven loss, or for it to be capped.
redlines.suggested_wording: In the event of delay the defaulting party shall compensate the other for loss actually suffered and proven, subject to a maximum of [X]% of the amount then outstanding.
redlines.fallback: If a fixed figure is unavoidable, ask for it to be mutual so that it applies to both sides' defaults.
